_doc: The bomb among the walkers looked at in play (look.gd): the camera stood on the walker nearest the middle of the generated town (the clock stopped), the Demolish drawer's Bomb tab, one charge at the walker's feet, the blast at 0.6 and 2 s of its own clock, then the bodies where they came to rest: the pieces cut off thrown as the people's own, a bone out of a stump now and then, the guts of a body opened and its organs over the street. The damage probe says how many chains of guts and bones are drawn.
